title: Incorrect handling of token decimals
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `previewDeposit()`, `previewMint()`, `previewWithdraw()` and `previewRedeem()` calculate returned amounts without accounting for the decimals of the `paymentToken`.  This can result in precision discrepancies during operations, leading to incorrect amounts being processed.  Assume the following scenario:  - The `paymentToken` has `18` decimals (e.g., `DAI`). - The `USD`+ token has `6` decimals.
